pages.title: Nanite Slurry
pages.text: A suspension of microscopic machines in water. The slurry moves on its own, shifting patterns across its surface as the nanites communicate. It feels faintly gritty and warm. Left in a bucket overnight, it rearranges itself into neat geometric ridges by morning.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Condensing a Nanite Swarm with water, the nanites spread through the liquid and began working together. The slurry could be poured into moulds and would build whatever they were told.
